title: Convolutional neural network detects diabetic retinopathy in Spanish and MESSIDOR images
summary: A convolutional neural network graded 14,186 retinographies from a Spanish diabetic population and 1,200 MESSIDOR images against four retina specialists. For any DR in the Spanish set AUC was 0.983 and for referable DR 0.988; on MESSIDOR the AUCs were 0.959 and 0.968. The study is retrospective and the training data are not described in the abstract.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network deep learning algorithm for retinography grading

evidence.tested: Testing against specialist grading on 14,186 local images and the public MESSIDOR set.
evidence.unknown: Training data and real-world screening outcome are not described; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Graded retinographies for any and referable diabetic retinopathy.
